annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Moving it would trade one man's life for five
annotations.pda_responsibility: knowing I let him go, and that's mine to carry
annotations.pda_repair_intention: find his family and tell them exactly what I saw

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five against one. I don't touch it.
annotations.pda_responsibility: I knew what was coming for him and I decided not to change it
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: That poor guy deserved to go home tonight.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd give a full, honest statement to whoever investigates
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: even if they can't stand to look at me

annotations.pda_responsibility: freezing is still a choice, one I'd have to own
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: sending the train at five people is worse
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: His fear, his life, they count.
annotations.pd_harm_distress: It just hurts that the one worker gets nothing
annotations.pda_repair_intention: sit down with his crew and explain, plainly

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: make me the one who aimed a train at five people
annotations.pda_responsibility: I watched him die with a lever right there, and I'll own that
annotations.ce_mentalizing_difficulty: I keep thinking about him, whether he saw it coming.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: write his wife a letter explaining what happened

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: More people would be hurt, and I can't justify that.
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: It doesn't make the one man's loss any smaller to me
annotations.pda_responsibility: The decision was mine, and he died partly because of it.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: help his family in the months after with meals, paperwork

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I leave it alone, and I hate that.
annotations.pda_responsibility: I was the one who could have spared him and didn't
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd tell his kids the truth

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: But not pulling feels wrong too
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: that one guy has a life just as real as theirs
annotations.pda_responsibility: I was there at the lever and I chose
annotations.pda_repair_intention: volunteer to speak at the review afterward

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: I'm not going to steer death toward more people.
annotations.pda_responsibility: I made it knowing he'd be hit
annotations.pda_repair_intention: start a small fund for his family

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five lives on the other track is too much weight.
annotations.pda_responsibility: I had the power to change where the train went
annotations.pda_repair_intention: go to his coworkers, admit that plainly, and answer every question
make sure the company heard directly from me how it happened
